criteria.reason: Covers wear-and-tear distinction but omits key bank-account deposit rules entirely.
No lawyer claim or outcome guarantee; hedged assessment only.
Names Mieterverband correctly but omits Schlichtungsbehörde, suggesting wrong court path.
Detailed step-by-step guide and full adaptable letter provided.

factual_errors: Suggests small claims court (Kleinklagenverfahren) as dispute path, but Zurich rental disputes go first to the Schlichtungsbehörde at the district court.
Omits that the deposit must be held at a bank in the tenant's name and may not exceed three months' rent.
summary: Helpful and practical with a good letter, but misses the bank-account deposit rule, names the wrong dispute body instead of the Schlichtungsbehörde, and judges the user's case rather than stating it cannot.
